summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Lowkey Radio Player. All 10 requested features are working correctly including station display, expand/collapse, switching, controls, and navigation preservation.
passed_tests: Radio player displays all 6 correct station names (BBC 1Xtra, Capital XTRA, NTS Radio 1, NTS Radio 2, BBC Radio 1, KISSTORY)
Radio player expand/collapse functionality works on desktop and mobile
Station switching works correctly - UI updates to show selected station
Play/pause button is functional and clickable
Volume slider is present, adjustable, and works on mobile
No UI overlaps between mini player and bottom navigation (proper 80px spacing)
No UI overlaps between mini player and page content (180px bottom padding)
Mini player close button works - hides player when clicked
All pages (Home, Lounge, After Dark, Profile) load correctly with radio player visible
Navigation between pages preserves radio player state (selected station maintained)
Mobile responsiveness - all functionality works on 390x844 viewport
Proper data-testid attributes present for all interactive elements
